'''''Girl and the River''''' ({{langx|fr|'''L'Eau vive'''|lit=Living Water}}) is a 1958 French [[drama film]] directed by [[François Villiers]]. It was entered into the [[1958 Cannes Film Festival]].<ref name="festival-cannes.com">{{cite web|url=http://www.festival-cannes.com/en/archives/ficheFilm/id/3483/year/1958.html |title=Festival de Cannes: Girl and the River |access-date=10 February 2009 |work=festival-cannes.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120915023120/http://www.festival-cannes.com/en/archives/ficheFilm/id/3483/year/1958.html |archive-date=15 September 2012  }}</ref>

==Reception==

[[Jean-Luc Godard]] considered it the best French film of 1958.<ref>Jean-Luc Godard, ''Godard par Godard'' (Flammarion, 1989; ISBN 978-2-08-081516-3), pp. 179-180.</ref>
